10.item: Valerian second edict (258): clergy to death, laity pressured apart — the gradus split
10.sense_relied_on: artful cruelty dividing clergy from laity, hoping the separated laity yield

10.item: milites Christi: soldiers of Christ (martyr commonplace)
10.sense_relied_on: dearest and most faithful soldiers of Christ

10.item: lenta et sera uictoria: slow and late victory (the delayed crown grieved, not feared)
10.sense_relied_on: grief that glory is kept waiting, not dread
